summary: Iteration 5 frontend-only testing of Profile page's new Alternative Number Update toggle + OtpModal enhancements. All targeted flows pass. Login (email+OTP 123456), Profile toggle off/on states, validation errors (alt-number-error/alt-person-error), Save->Confirm->OTP flow with 'Verifying...' loading state, wrong OTP error (no save), success toasts ('Alternative contact details updated successfully.' and 'Alternative number is set as the priority number.'), priority-number-badge visible+persistent after refresh, priority OFF -> no badge, Contact Person Details independent (both toggles can be on simultaneously, saving CP alone leaves alt fields untouched at seed values 91234 56780 / Krishna Rao), Profile updated toast, persistence across reload+logout, rapid click stability (no duplicate submissions), mobile 375px no horizontal overflow, all UI elements usable. Regression: shared OtpModal login flow still works, forgot-password modal opens.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.jsx doSave uses functional set with in-place mutation of st.profile — works with the existing store (immer-like) but relies on that convention; consider always returning a new object for safety.
OTP expiry (60s) was verified via code review (Date.now() - sentAt > 60000 check + Resend resets sentAt); wall-clock 60s wait skipped for time efficiency — expiry+resend logic correctness is sound.
Forgot Password modal uses different testids (input isn't 'forgot-email-input'); not part of this iteration's scope but noting for future test scripts.
seed_data_creation: None; used built-in seed. Reset Demo Data available on Profile page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11+ tests from the review request pass. Profile alt-number update flow, OtpModal shared behavior (verifying label, error, resend), priority badge, CP independence, mobile responsiveness verified.
